text:
maya: Huge shoutout to @devon and @amanda for swooping in on the last-minute demo fixes yesterday. customer call went from 'uh-oh' to 'wow' in 20 minutes :sparkles:

devon: we just triaged the flaky auth redirect and pre-warmed the canary. honestly it was a team scramble, amanda drove the slides and timing.

amanda: pancake debugging at 3pm, slide redesign at 3:10pm. proud to be the human duct tape :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye: glad the GIF landed well with the execs.

noah: I was in the call — that quick visual tweak made the product flow so much clearer. y'all saved the day. sending virtual high-fives. :handshake:

maya: also want to call out the handoff doc amanda dropped in #product before the call. super clear notes, timestamps, and the 'what not to mention' section saved us from a tangent.

marketingbot: Kudos logged: #KUDOS-482 created for devon, amanda. Reward: 2 coffee vouchers + 1 team shoutout in newsletter. :trophy:

devon: wow thanks marketingbot and @maya. coffee vouchers accepted.
amanda: newsletter mention is the real prize tbh. thanks everyone 1:00pm heroics feel good.
maya: Let's nominate them for the monthly "Cross-Team MVP" — cc @people-ops in #people-ops-noms. Also, lunch on me next week. :sandwich:
